title: N-Queens Solver - Solution
intuition: The n-queens puzzle is the problem of placing n queens on an n x n chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Return total solutions count.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(n):
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set() # r - c
    diag2 = set() # r + c
    count = 0
    def backtrack(r):
        nonlocal count
        if r == n:
            count += 1
            return
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or (r - c) in diag1 or (r + c) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.add(c)
            diag1.add(r - c)
            diag2.add(r + c)
            backtrack(r + 1)
            cols.remove(c)
            diag1.remove(r - c)
            diag2.remove(r + c)
    backtrack(0)
    return count
common_mistakes: Use backtracking. Track occupied columns and diagonals (positive and negative slope) to place queens row-by-row safely.
